title: 第二十三章 湖边的少年情怀第二十四章 男儿铮铮女儿情
content_zh:
陆原就不紧不慢的跟着周允。
一直跟到了学校镜湖边，一个很安静的地方，这里有几丛灌木，挡住视线，目光越过宽大的镜湖，可以看到远处有依稀的人影。
周允面对着镜湖在这里坐下来，这才小心翼翼的拿出刚才买的香草冰淇淋，小口的吃起来。
陆原此时就在她身后不远处，看到周允这样，心里也不禁摇了摇头，唉，这女生虽然出生贫困，但是并没有那种穷人家孩子的坚韧。
看她的样子，200块钱对她来说，应该是不小的一笔数目了。
但是却被用来买一个巴掌大不到的冰淇淋。
就看到周允小心的舔了几口冰淇淋，又把冰淇淋小心的放在了旁边的草地上。
然后就看到她双臂交错，抱着自己的肩膀，低下了头，满头秀发宛若珠帘一样散落，过了一会儿，陆原就看到她双肩微微抖动。
心里不禁一怔，怎么感觉好像是在哭啊？
陆原正奇怪着，又看到周允突然跪在了地上，开始磕头。
陆原更奇怪了，这妮子不会是神经有问题吧？
是啊，肯定是神经方面有点问题，不然为什么那三个女生欺负她的时候，一声不吭，从始至终都不说话？
而且，正常人也不会在自己穷的时候买这么贵的东西吃啊。
现在又跪着磕头，行为模式都很奇怪。
除了神经病，实在找不出什么别的原因了。
陆原心里重重的叹了口气，唉，长得这么好看的一个女孩子，竟然是个神经病。
算了，还是走吧。
想着，陆原转身就要离开。
不料就在这时，周允突然从地上爬起来，径直向镜湖里走去。
一开始，陆原觉得这妮子是精神有问题，行为异于常人，所以也没在意，不过眼看着周允越走越远，越走越深，一直向镜湖的中心走去，此时，水深都快要没入她的脑袋了，这妮子还没有丝毫的停下来的迹象。

猛然，陆原心里闪过一个不详的念头，莫非，这妮子要自杀？！
这里四处无人，这么安静，她特意找的这个地方？
来不及多想了，陆原不可能眼看着她就这样溺水，扑通一声跳入水中，手脚并用，翻爬到周允的身边。
“放开我！放开我！”
谁料周允竟然丝毫不合作，一边极力推开陆原，一边继续向湖水中间走去。
陆原可不理会她怎么做，忍受着被她的抓挠，硬是拖抱着她，把这妮子给救到了岸上来。
“为什么要救我，为什么不让我去死？！”
虽然被救上来，但是周允情绪却显得很激动，用恼火的目光瞪着陆原，那目光里似乎还有埋怨和愠怒。
陆原都看呆了，原来长得漂亮的女孩子，连发火都这么好看。
周允此时秀发湿漉，刘海上还有水滴慢慢的滴落，脸上是泪痕和水痕交映，看起来宛若春雨梨花。
她的眼睛本来就带有烟水的气息，就算是正常看人，都带有一种天然的文艺风情，此时虽然是恼火的瞪着陆原，但是却让人不但不觉得凶狠，反而只是觉得一种倔强的美感。
不过陆原一听到她的话，心态就炸了。
也忍不住了。
“是啊，我为什么要救你呢，为什么不让你死呢！”陆原也怒了，不是因为周允怼自己，而是对于周允的这一系列行为的愤怒，“你也是有父母的，你有没有想过你自杀了，你父母会怎么想，你有没有想过他们的感受啊！”
“你父母含辛茹苦把你养大成人，还供你学费读书，你还没有回报他们就一死了之，你对得起他们吗！”
“还有啊，你看看你，贪图口舌，爱慕虚荣，看你的家境也不富裕吧，为什么要买这么贵的哈根达斯吃啊，你这么大手大脚的花钱，家里人知道吗！你有想过你父母赚钱的不容易吗！”
陆原一口气，把内心想说的，全部倾泻了出来。
本来，陆原以为自己这么咆哮着说出这些话，周允会更加恼火更加愤怒，甚至会和自己大骂起来的。
然而，他没有想到的是。
周允听着听着，竟然突然眼睛一红，泪水也一刹那，宛若决堤的洪水。

“不许你说我父母，不许你说他们……”
周允不再看陆原了，又抱起肩膀，低着头大哭起来，肩膀抖动的比刚才更厉害了。
“我吃一次哈根达斯怎么了，我吃一次哈根达斯怎么了……”周允一边哭着一边抽噎着说道，“我就要死了，我就要离开这个世界了，在我临死之前，我吃一次哈根达斯不行吗！”
“为什么你们所有人都要指责我，艾敬她们骂我虚荣，围观的学生也指责我虚荣，你现在也说我贪图享乐，可是我根本就不是这样的人，我每天在食堂里都吃最便宜的菜，有时候甚至只打一点白饭，然后用酱油泡着吃掉，我怕别人嘲笑，不敢在食堂这么吃，也不敢回寝室吃，所以我把酱油藏在这里，每天打了白饭，就到这里来吃！”
content_en:
Lu Yuan followed Zhou Yun unhurriedly.
We followed him until we reached the edge of the school's Mirror Lake, a very quiet place. There were a few bushes blocking our view. Looking across the wide Mirror Lake, we could see vague figures in the distance.
Zhou Yun sat down here facing Jinghu Lake, then carefully took out the vanilla ice cream he just bought and ate it in small bites.
Lu Yuan was not far behind her at this time. Seeing Zhou Yun like this, he couldn't help but shake his head. Alas, although this girl was born in poverty, she did not have the tenacity of a child from a poor family.
Judging from her appearance, 200 yuan should be a lot of money for her.
But it was used to buy ice cream that was no bigger than a palm.
I saw Zhou Yun carefully licking a few mouthfuls of the ice cream, and then carefully placing the ice cream on the grass next to it.
Then he saw her arms crossed, holding her shoulders, lowering her head, her hair scattered like a bead curtain. After a while, Lu Yuan saw her shoulders shaking slightly.
I couldn't help but feel startled, why did it feel like I was crying?
Lu Yuan was wondering when he saw Zhou Yun suddenly kneeling on the ground and starting to kowtow.
Lu Yuan was even more surprised. Could this girl have a mental problem?
Yes, there must be some neurological problem, otherwise why did the three girls remain silent when they bullied her?
Moreover, normal people would not buy such expensive things to eat when they are poor.
Now he is kneeling and kowtowing again, and his behavior is very strange.
Apart from neurosis, I really can't find any other reason.
Lu Yuan sighed heavily in his heart, alas, such a good-looking girl turned out to be a psychopath.
Forget it, let's go.
Thinking about it, Lu Yuan turned around and left.
Unexpectedly, at this moment, Zhou Yun suddenly got up from the ground and walked straight into Jinghu Lake.
At first, Lu Yuan thought that this girl had a mental problem and behaved differently than ordinary people, so he didn't care. However, he watched Zhou Yun walk farther and farther, deeper and deeper, towards the center of Jinghu Lake. At this time, the water was almost deep enough to sink into her head, and this girl showed no sign of stopping.
Suddenly, an unknown thought flashed through Lu Yuan's mind. Could it be that this girl is going to commit suicide? !
There's no one here, it's so quiet, did she find this place specifically?
There was no time to think too much. Lu Yuan couldn't watch her drowning like this. He jumped into the water with a splash and climbed to Zhou Yun's side using his hands and feet.
"Let me go! Let me go!"
Unexpectedly, Zhou Yun did not cooperate at all. He pushed Lu Yuan away while continuing to walk towards the middle of the lake.
Lu Yuan ignored what she did and endured being scratched by her. He just dragged her and rescued the girl to the shore.
"Why save me, why don't you let me die?!"
Although he was rescued, Zhou Yun seemed very excited and stared at Lu Yuan with an annoyed look, which seemed to contain complaints and sullenness.
Lu Yuan was stunned. It turned out that a beautiful girl could look so good even when she was angry.
Zhou Yun's hair was wet at this time, and there were water droplets slowly dripping from his bangs. His face was stained with tears and water stains, making him look like pear blossoms in the spring rain.
Her eyes always had the smell of smoke and water, and even when she looked at people normally, they had a natural literary and artistic charm. Although she was glaring at Lu Yuan angrily at this moment, not only did she not feel fierce, but she just felt a kind of stubborn beauty.
But as soon as Lu Yuan heard her words, his mood exploded.
I couldn’t help it anymore.
"Yeah, why should I save you? Why don't I let you die!" Lu Yuan was also angry, not because Zhou Yun was criticizing himself, but because he was angry at Zhou Yun's series of actions. "You also have parents. Have you ever thought about your suicide? What will your parents think? Have you ever thought about their feelings?"
"Your parents worked hard toYou raised them and paid for your education, but you died before they could repay them. Are you worthy of them? "
"Also, look at you, you are greedy for words and vain. It seems that your family is not rich. Why do you buy such expensive Haagen-Dazs? Do your family members know that you spend money so lavishly? Have you ever thought about how difficult it is for your parents to make money? "
Lu Yuan poured out everything he wanted to say in one breath.
Originally, Lu Yuan thought that Zhou Yun would be even more annoyed and angry if he said these words in such a roar, and would even start yelling at him.
However, what he didn't expect was.
As Zhou Yun listened, his eyes suddenly turned red and he burst into tears, like a flood bursting from a dam.
"You are not allowed to talk about my parents, you are not allowed to talk about them..."
Zhou Yun stopped looking at Lu Yuan, hugged his shoulders again, lowered his head and cried loudly, his shoulders shaking even more than before.
"What's wrong if I eat Haagen-Dazs once? What's wrong if I eat Haagen-Dazs once..." Zhou Yun said while crying and sobbing, "I'm about to die, I'm about to leave this world. Before I die, can't I eat Haagen-Dazs once?" "
"Why are you all accusing me? Ai Jing and the others scolded me for being vain, and the students who were watching also accused me of being vain. You are now saying that I am greedy for pleasure, but I am not such a person at all. I eat the cheapest food in the cafeteria every day. Sometimes I even just buy a little white rice, and then soak it in soy sauce and eat it. I am afraid of being laughed at, so I don't dare to eat like this in the cafeteria, and I don't dare to go back to the dormitory to eat, so I hide the soy sauce here, buy white rice every day, and come here to eat! "
